title: 重试乱序与幂等生产者的序列号纠正
expected_output:
=== 重试导致的乱序：max.in.flight 与幂等开关的联合效果 ===

发送顺序: m1(seq=1) 超时 -> 先发 m2(seq=2), m3(seq=3) -> 再重试 m1

场景 A  max.in.flight=1（串行发送, 无重试）
    broker 落盘顺序: ['m1', 'm2', 'm3']

场景 B  max.in.flight=5, 未开幂等, m1 重试
    broker 落盘顺序: ['m2', 'm3', 'm1-retry']   <- 乱序！

场景 C  max.in.flight=5, 开启幂等, m1 重试
    发送 seq=2 (m2) -> buffered（等待 seq=1）
    发送 seq=3 (m3) -> buffered（等待 seq=1）
    发送 seq=1 (m1-retry) -> appended
    broker 落盘顺序: ['m1-retry', 'm2', 'm3']   <- 顺序恢复

场景 D  开启幂等 + 同一批重试重复发送
    发送 seq=1 (m1) -> appended
    发送 seq=1 (m1-retry) -> dup-dropped（重试重复）
    发送 seq=2 (m2) -> appended
    broker 落盘顺序: ['m1', 'm2']（重复被丢弃）

-> 未开幂等时, in.flight>1 会让重试的旧消息排到新消息之后（乱序）
-> 开启幂等后 broker 按 (PID, partition, seq) 校验: 乱序消息被缓存等待, 重复被丢弃
-> 这正是「幂等生产者顺带解决乱序」的机制来源, 也是它允许 in.flight<=5 的前提
code:
print("=== 重试导致的乱序：max.in.flight 与幂等开关的联合效果 ===")
print()

class Broker:
    """按 (PID, partition) 维护期望序列号；开启幂等时缓存乱序到达的消息。"""

    def __init__(self, idempotent):
        self.idempotent = idempotent
        self.log = []
        self.expect = {}
        self.buf = {}

    def append(self, pid, seq, payload):
        if not self.idempotent:
            self.log.append(payload)
            return "appended"
        exp = self.expect.get(pid, 1)
        if seq < exp:
            return "dup-dropped（重试重复）"
        if seq == exp:
            self.log.append(payload)
            self.expect[pid] = exp + 1
            self._drain(pid)
            return "appended"
        self.buf.setdefault(pid, {})[seq] = payload
        return "buffered（等待 seq=%d）" % exp

    def _drain(self, pid):
        b = self.buf.get(pid, {})
        exp = self.expect.get(pid, 1)
        while exp in b:
            self.log.append(b.pop(exp))
            exp += 1
            self.expect[pid] = exp


print("发送顺序: m1(seq=1) 超时 -> 先发 m2(seq=2), m3(seq=3) -> 再重试 m1")
print()

b1 = Broker(False)
for seq, p in ((1, "m1"), (2, "m2"), (3, "m3")):
    b1.append(0, seq, p)
print("场景 A  max.in.flight=1（串行发送, 无重试）")
print("    broker 落盘顺序: %s" % b1.log)
print()

b2 = Broker(False)
for seq, p in ((2, "m2"), (3, "m3"), (1, "m1-retry")):
    b2.append(0, seq, p)
print("场景 B  max.in.flight=5, 未开幂等, m1 重试")
print("    broker 落盘顺序: %s   <- 乱序！" % b2.log)
print()

b3 = Broker(True)
print("场景 C  max.in.flight=5, 开启幂等, m1 重试")
for seq, p in ((2, "m2"), (3, "m3"), (1, "m1-retry")):
    print("    发送 seq=%d (%s) -> %s" % (seq, p, b3.append(7, seq, p)))
print("    broker 落盘顺序: %s   <- 顺序恢复" % b3.log)
print()

b4 = Broker(True)
print("场景 D  开启幂等 + 同一批重试重复发送")
for seq, p in ((1, "m1"), (1, "m1-retry"), (2, "m2")):
    print("    发送 seq=%d (%s) -> %s" % (seq, p, b4.append(7, seq, p)))
print("    broker 落盘顺序: %s（重复被丢弃）" % b4.log)
print()
print("-> 未开幂等时, in.flight>1 会让重试的旧消息排到新消息之后（乱序）")
print("-> 开启幂等后 broker 按 (PID, partition, seq) 校验: 乱序消息被缓存等待, 重复被丢弃")
print("-> 这正是「幂等生产者顺带解决乱序」的机制来源, 也是它允许 in.flight<=5 的前提")
